kicker_prefix: KP4 · Designing Digital Government Services · Module 3
audience: The head of a sectoral ICT unit, or the project lead, who accepts the design

videos.title: One goal, written as a story a builder can follow
videos.message: The builder must not have to work anything out or ask anybody anything.

videos.title: Every way it can go wrong, written down
videos.message: A story is finished only when every failure has its own ending.

videos.title: Screens worked out from the story, every value with its source
videos.message: Each screen serves a step; each value on it says where it comes from.

videos.title: Screens officers can use
videos.message: An officer never types what the system already knows, and never chooses from an endless list.

videos.title: The walk-through your officials click
videos.message: The walk-through is produced from the written screens, never drawn by hand, and every page shows its version.

videos.title: The review: three people, every open line given a name
videos.message: The owner, the builder and the person who will live with the result agree the screens; nothing leaves the room unowned.
